title: Tech Note: Database Normalization
author: Timothy Tse, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Primary keys and one-to-many relationships in 4D

historical_commentary.text: Database normalization is foundational relational-database theory rooted in mathematics and set theory, and it has not changed in the decades since (and before) this note was published. The 4D-specific framing — one-to-many relations as 4D's only native relationship type — reflects the classic-language relational model of the era, which 4D's later ORDA layer built entity-based, dot-notation access on top of, but the underlying normalization principles apply identically whether data is queried via classic relations or accessed as ORDA entities. This is a rare example in this era of content that remains genuinely current rather than superseded.
